name: frontend-navigate-pm4-hardened
purpose: iter-460: frontend_navigate_hardened.json verbatim through select-third, with the measurement step re-keyed for the PM4 draw path. The HLE-era 'observe-gameplay' required a SUSTAINED BLACK loading screen after the third selection; under the PM4 path the load screen is drawn, so that gate reports 'era never entered' on a run that reaches the street (archive/p2_reach1). The era witness here is the guest's own main-HUD package request (gameplay_trace.json 'await-main-hud-request': an APT witness, not proof of a level or a player entity), followed by a time dwell so the present dumps cover the 3D era. No pixel or present number is pinned.

steps.name: await-ui-tail
steps.purpose: The exact named HintB request = the UI request tail proxy (APT_REQ #15 in the valid rolls; ScrGenPop, the dialog itself, is #16). NOT proof the dialog is ready - the settle + single-deadline pulses own that risk.

steps.name: settle-dialog
steps.purpose: Bounded settle after the request tail.

steps.name: clear-dialog
steps.purpose: Accept the storage dialog against ONE absolute deadline (the legacy driver waited expectMs twice). Confirmed transition = the runtime XamShowDeviceSelectorUI(user= invocation, never the import banner. DELIVERED only proves the guest sampled A.

steps.name: settle-modepage
steps.purpose: Let the mode-select page finish coming up before navigating it.

steps.name: select-mode
steps.purpose: Press A on whatever is focused. Blind by necessity - the item text does not render.

steps.name: nav-down
steps.purpose: Move the selection. DOWN is an EXTENDED key - without KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY the guest never sees it (iter-450V).

steps.name: nav-up-select
steps.purpose: And the other direction, in case the first item was the wrong one.

steps.name: await-main-hud-request
steps.purpose: The GUEST requests the in-game HUD package set: an APT witness of the era, nothing more (director ruling iter-453).

steps.name: settle-gameplay
steps.purpose: Dwell so the sparse present dumps cover the 3D era (iter-458: the HUD presents ~16 s after the request).
